name: PagerDuty
summary: Trigger, acknowledge and resolve PagerDuty alerts from Ogun workflows through Events API v2, in the US or EU service region.

fields.name: routing_key
fields.label: Routing key
fields.help: The integration key of an Events API v2 integration on a service. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: service_region
settings.label: Service region
settings.help: us uses events.pagerduty.com; eu uses events.eu.pagerduty.com.

settings.name: source
settings.label: Event source
settings.help: Names the system that raised the alert.

egress.note: Only the host of the chosen service region is used.

operators.summary: Send a trigger, acknowledge or resolve event to PagerDuty, deduplicated by key.

notes: Events go to /v2/enqueue on the host of the chosen region. An event that repeats a dedup_key updates the same alert instead of opening another. The routing key is a secret and never reaches logs, events or lineage.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
